body:
Scholarship Sponsor says "a number of basic land cards less than or equal to the difference" between the most lands and their own.

Old: `FindNumberCardsOfType(Minus(TheNumberOfPermanentsOnTheBattlefield(...ControlledByAPlayer(SinglePlayer(EachablePlayer))...), ValueX), ...)`
New: `FindUptoNumberCardsOfType(Minus(ValueX, TheNumberOfPermanentsOnTheBattlefield(...ControlledByAPlayer(SinglePlayer(EachablePlayer))...)), ...)`

The difference is backwards (zero or less), and the count is exact instead of up to.

comments.body:
When searching your library, you always have the option of not find any, or finding up to the number of cards you are requested to find. So ``FindNumberCardsOfType`` is the correct form here.

``FindUptoNumberCardsOfType`` does exist when searching public zones in addition to your library, ex: "search your library and graveyard for up to ...".

Keeping ``FindNumberCardsOfType``, fixing the minus being swapped.

title: Scholarship Sponsor: the difference is backwards, and not "up to"
